entries.title: Deal with US not imminent, Iran says
entries.snippet: The US secretary of state earlier said that an agreement could possibly come on Monday.

entries.snippet: Trump said on Saturday that an agreement would include the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz, without giving further details.

entries.title: She was told to marry in a country which bans girls' education. So she got in a taxi and fled
entries.snippet: Nearly five years on from Afghanistan's school ban, young women say they have waved goodbye to their dreams.

entries.title: Large-scale Russian attack on Ukraine leaves four dead and dozens injured
entries.snippet: A hypersonic missile, which reportedly travels over 10 times the speed of sound, was used, Russia has confirmed.

entries.title: Anger grows after China's deadliest coal mining disaster in years
entries.snippet: On China's tightly-controlled internet, people are calling for justice and questioning how this happened.

entries.title: At least 19 people taken to hospital after 'strong smell' reported at Tokyo mall
entries.snippet: Police say a man sprayed a substance at an ATM in the luxury Ginza 6 shopping centre.

entries.title: First Hong Kong astronaut launches into space onboard Chinese mission
entries.snippet: The 43-year-old police officer and mother of three serves as the team's payload scientist.

entries.title: Clashes as Venezuelan prisoners protest over alleged mistreatment
entries.snippet: The prisoners insisted their protest was peaceful but that security forces deployed to quell it opened fire.

entries.title: Turkish riot police storm opposition offices after leaders ousted
entries.snippet: Officers forced their way into the building days after the party vowed to defy a court ruling removing its leaders.

entries.title: Blast targeting train kills at least 20 in Pakistan
entries.snippet: Officials say the train had been transporting military personnel home for Eid when it was attacked by armed separatists.

entries.title: Senegal's leadership row mounts as parliament speaker resigns
entries.snippet: Some speculate that El Malick Ndiaye stepped down so that ousted-PM Ousmane Sonko can take his place.

entries.title: Man killed in shark attack off Australia's north-east coast
entries.snippet: The 39-year-old was fatally injured at a shoal off the Cassowary Coast in Queensland, apparently while spearfishing.

entries.title: Suspect killed after opening fire on Secret Service near White House
entries.snippet: Officials say a suspect approached a checkpoint near the building and opened fire, and that a bystander was wounded.

entries.title: One killed and many feared trapped under collapsed building in Philippines
entries.snippet: A Malaysian man has died and about 20 people are feared trapped at the site near Manila, officials say.

entries.title: Ebola outbreak poses massive challenges, warns nurse
entries.snippet: Kate White says she is "extremely concerned about the inability to get resources" to the Democratic Republic of Congo.

entries.title: Bolivian minister's convoy ambushed while overseeing roadblock clearance
entries.snippet: Security forces were met by resistance while attempting to clear highway barriers, amid unrest over the government's economic policies.

entries.title: Currently no active leak from failing chemical tank, California officials say
entries.snippet: The tank, which contains a highly volatile and flammable substance, has been at risk of either a major spillage or an explosion.

entries.title: Morocco wants tourists to visit Western Sahara. Some say it's tightening its control
entries.snippet: The Moroccan government wants more Western holidaymakers to visit the territory it claims to own.

entries.title: Indian billionaires buy foreign companies as growth slows at home
entries.snippet: India Inc spent $18bn on global buyouts in 2025 and the deal value could cross $15bn in the first half of 2026.

entries.title: Trump says U.S. and Iran nearing a peace deal. And, Pope Leo weighs in on AI's rise
entries.snippet: President Trump says that a deal with Iran to end the war is largely negotiated. And, Pope Leo XIV weighed in today on the rise of AI during his first encyclical.

entries.title: U.S.-Iran peace deal emerging, while war threats still loom
entries.snippet: President Trump and other administration officials are tempering expectations raised of an imminent agreement to end the war in Iran while Iranian officials have signaled there are still disagreements on key issues.

entries.title: In Beirut, refugee girls and women learn more than self-defense in martial arts class
entries.snippet: In the male-dominated world of Palestinian refugee camps in Lebanon, a martial arts teacher offers women a way to empowerment.

entries.title: Pope Leo takes aim at big tech in sweeping encyclical on AI
entries.snippet: "Magnifica Humanitas" tackles the social, economic and political challenges associated with artificial intelligence.

entries.title: Diners are staying home, so this restaurant lets patrons pay what they want
entries.snippet: Americans are increasingly passing up on dining out. So one restaurant is allowing diners to pay what they like for their food.

entries.title: 'My body carried me,' Elizabeth Smart says. Now she's celebrating it
entries.snippet: Her abduction at age 14 drew international attention. After her rescue, Smart says she struggled with feeling shame around her body. Bodybuilding has helped her see herself differently.

entries.title: This big university system is embracing AI. Students and faculty aren't all on board
entries.snippet: The California State University system offers an early look at what happens when an administration commits to a technology that its own community isn't convinced will improve education.

entries.title: COMIC: To raise a confident little talker, learn to speak 'parentese'
entries.snippet: So you've got a baby in your life. How do you talk to them, exactly? In this comic, experts explain why conversing with your baby is important — and share ways to help them develop their language skills.

entries.title: Spin to win: How this life insurance company turns healthy habits into a game
entries.snippet: You've heard of lower car insurance rates for good drivers. Now, one life insurance company wants to incentivize longevity with lower rates and extra bonuses for people who adopt healthy habits.

entries.title: Morning news brief
entries.snippet: Trump touts breakthrough in negotiations to end Iran war, Middle Eastern countries react to news of a potential deal to end war, Africa races to contain a fast-spreading Ebola outbreak.

entries.title: Trump's emerging plan to end Iran war draws criticism from hard-line Republicans
entries.snippet: President Donald Trump's emerging deal to end the Iran war is drawing heavy criticism from some fellow Republicans who favor a harder line against the government in Tehran and fear a lost opportunity to finally rein in a longtime Mideast nemesis.

entries.title: Syria holds legislative elections in Kurdish-majority northeast
entries.snippet: Syria held follow-up parliamentary elections on Sunday in the Kurdish-majority northeastern province of Hassakeh and the town of Kobani, areas that were reintegrated under government control after fighting in January.

entries.title: Turkish police force entry into CHP offices, fire tear gas and rubber bullets
entries.snippet: Police stormed the offices of Turkey's main opposition CHP party on Sunday, firing tear gas and rubber bullets at party supporters and officials who had been holed up inside for three days.

entries.title: Trump says not to rush as U.S. nears potential Iran deal
entries.snippet: The United States is close to reaching a deal with Iran that would end the war, reopen the Strait of Hormuz and see Iran give up its stockpile of highly enriched uranium, regional officials told The Associated Press on Sunday.

entries.title: Rubio aims to rebuild trust between Washington and Delhi during first official visit to India
entries.snippet: U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio held bilateral talks with his Indian counterpart Subrahmanyam Jaishankar on Sunday as the two countries look to steady ties that have fallen to their lowest point in over two decades.

entries.title: Looksmaxxing may point to deeper body image issues in young men, mental health expert says
entries.snippet: A mental health professional explains how sensationalizing the extreme behaviors associated with "looksmaxxing," rather than treating them as symptoms of mental health issues, can prevent boys and young men from receiving the care they need.

entries.title: China launches latest Shenzhou mission with 1 of 3 astronauts preparing for a yearlong stay
entries.snippet: China launched the Shenzhou 23 spacecraft Sunday night with three astronauts heading to its space station, including one set to stay in space for a year.

entries.title: Mountain guide Kenton Cool climbs Everest for 20th time and says he's not ready to quit yet
entries.snippet: Briton Kenton Cool scaled the peak for the 20th time, breaking his own record for the most ascents of the world's highest mountain by a non-Sherpa guide.

entries.title: Thousands protest rising housing costs in Spain's capital
entries.snippet: Thousands of people rallied in central Madrid on Sunday against spiraling housing costs that have priced many Spaniards out of the housing market despite a recent economic boom, particularly in cities such as the capital and Barcelona.

entries.title: Suspect killed after firing shots near White House security checkpoint, Secret Service says
entries.snippet: A man who opened fire Saturday near a White House security checkpoint is dead after being shot by officers who returned fire, the U.S. Secret Service said.

entries.title: Venezuelan opposition leader Machado says she will run again for presidency and return from exile by late 2026
entries.snippet: Venezuela's Nobel Peace Prize laureate María Corina Machado announced on Saturday that she plans to run for president again and intends to return to her home country before the end of 2026.

entries.title: Iran's soccer federation says its World Cup base camp has been moved to Mexico from the United States
entries.snippet: The president of the governing body of Iranian soccer said Saturday the nation's World Cup training base has been moved to Mexico from the United States after getting approval from FIFA.

entries.title: Marines conduct rapid response exercise at U.S. Embassy in Venezuela's capital
entries.snippet: Two Marine Corps Osprey aircraft, which have characteristics of both a helicopter and a fixed-wing airplane, flew over the recently reopened U.S. Embassy in Caracas.

entries.title: 40,000 under evacuation orders after chemical tank leak in Southern California
entries.snippet: Authorities in Southern California on Friday were racing to figure out how to prevent the explosion of a storage tank that has been leaking a hazardous chemical used to make plastic parts, as some 40,000 people were under evacuation orders in the area.

entries.title: Gunmen open fire in 2 separate attacks in Honduras, killing at least 25
entries.snippet: Gunmen opened fire in two separate attacks Thursday on the Honduran coast, killing at least 25 people, including six police officers, authorities said.

entries.title: Trump says deal with Iran, including opening Strait of Hormuz, is 'largely negotiated'
entries.snippet: President Donald Trump said Saturday that a deal with Iran on the war, including opening the Strait of Hormuz, has been "largely negotiated" after calls with Israel and other allies in the region.

entries.title: Kyle Busch died after severe pneumonia led to sepsis, his family says
entries.snippet: Kyle Busch died after severe pneumonia progressed into sepsis, resulting in rapid and overwhelming complications, according to a statement released by his family.

entries.title: Deadliest coal mine explosion in years kills at least 82 people in China, state media say
entries.snippet: A gas explosion at a coal mine in China's northern Shanxi province killed at least 82 people, local officials said Saturday, in what was the country's deadliest mining accident in recent years.

entries.title: Explosion at New York City shipyard kills 1 and injures 36, officials say
entries.snippet: One person has died after a fire and two explosions Friday at a New York City shipyard, officials say.

entries.title: Eighteen suspected Ebola patients escape after treatment tent is set on fire for a second time in Congo
entries.snippet: Angry residents of a town at the epicenter of the Ebola outbreak in eastern Congo attacked and burned a tent that was part of a health center where people are being treated for the virus, the staff there said Saturday.

entries.title: DW
entries.snippet: News, Analysis and Service from Germany and Europe - in 30 Languages

entries.title: Uganda confirms 2 new Ebola cases, DRC infections hit 900
entries.snippet: The two new cases are health workers in the Ugandan capital, Kampala. The WHO has declared a public health emergency over the latest outbreak, which began in neighboring Democratic Republic of Congo.

entries.title: Hidden femicide risk grows in Afghanistan
entries.snippet: As poverty deepens and the Taliban curtails women's rights, domestic violence in Afghanistan is becoming more dangerous, less visible and harder to escape.

entries.title: Chinese human rights cases in limbo after Trump-Xi summit
entries.snippet: Trump and Xi said they had discussed political prisoners in China, including Hong Kong media tycoon Jimmy Lai. Ahead of Xi's September visit to Washington, advocates are urging the US to apply more pressure on China.

entries.title: Iran war: No deal close despite some progress — Tehran
entries.snippet: Washington and Iran have presented conflicting assessments on the prospects for a peace deal. Oil prices have fallen despite the uncertainty. DW has the latest.

entries.title: Enhanced Games: Gkolomeev 'breaks' record in 50m freestyle
entries.snippet: Records set at the divisive competition are not considered official because athletes are allowed to take performance-enhancing drugs. The global swimming body has condemned the event as a "circus, built on short-cuts."

entries.title: Germany news: More than 1,900 missing children
entries.snippet: Authorities say there are 1,933 missing children cases nationwide, up 6.8% from the year before. And, travellers in Germany seem nervous when it comes to air travel, amid the war in Iran, a survey suggests. Follow DW.

entries.title: New Zealand: Surfing contest halted after suspected shark attack
entries.snippet: A surfing competition was thrown into chaos after a photographer was bitten in the water, triggering fears of a shark attack. The culprit, later, turned out to be a sea lion.

entries.title: Germany's Dr. Wolff cosmetics company is going all in on AI
entries.snippet: This medium-sized, family-run business has embraced artificial intelligence to stay competitive. All employees are encouraged to learn about and apply LLMs.

entries.title: Iran war: Trump says US won't 'rush into' deal with Tehran
entries.snippet: The US president says negotiations are proceeding in "an orderly and constructive manner," while Iranian officials say key differences still need to be settled. Follow DW for more.

entries.title: Blinded by the light pollution: Cities seek to restore night
entries.snippet: Artificial lights are blotting out the moon and stars, harming human health, and disrupting the natural world. Why is this a problem? And how can we stop it without sitting in the dark?

entries.title: Why are Europe's biggest defense projects in trouble?
entries.snippet: Disputes over leadership, military priorities and industrial control are threatening to fracture Europe's €100 billion fighter jet project — with tensions now spilling into a Franco-German tank project as well.

entries.title: Peacekeeping missions at risk due to cuts, tensions — report
entries.snippet: A "perfect storm" of falling troop numbers, geopolitical tensions and funding crises is jeopardizing international peacekeeping efforts, a new study has warned.

entries.title: Cuba receives China rice shipment amid US threats, blackouts
entries.snippet: Chinese aid is expected to alleviate food shortages in Cuba. But the island's economic crisis continues with blackouts and oil embargos are compunded by threats from the United States.

entries.title: China mine blast: Search and investigation continue
entries.snippet: Chinese authorities have launched an investigation into "serious breaches" of security regulations after an explosion in a coal mine left at least 82 people dead. Two people remain missing.

entries.title: Madrid protesters decry rising rents and housing shortage
entries.snippet: Housing has long ranked among the top concerns in Spain, where demand has risen because of tourism and immigration-driven population growth.

entries.title: Turkish police evict ousted CHP leaders from party HQ
entries.snippet: Police forced their way into the opposition party's headquarters, ending a standoff between ousted CHP leader Ozgur Ozel and supporters of court-appointed Kemal Kilicdaroglu.

entries.title: Germany plans to address growing use of date-rape drugs
entries.snippet: Germany's justice minister is seeking harsher penalties for the use of date-rape drugs in sexual assaults. But victims say more needs to be done about a growing problem.

entries.title: Cyprus: Voters boost far right in parliamentary election
entries.snippet: The results dealt a blow to the three centrist parties in President Nikos Christodoulides' minority coalition. The vote is seen as a gauge of voter sentiment ahead of a presidential election in 2028.

entries.title: New Chinese surveillance leaves foreigners nowhere to hide
entries.snippet: A Chinese cybersecurity expert has revealed to DW details of China's new high-tech policing. From ski resort facial recognition to seats on a train, the system can track anyone and compile a "holistic profile."
